# Miri Consulting

> Miri Consulting helps US landscape, snow, and construction companies get more value from their software and systems — especially Aspire — by improving setup, accounting workflows, job costing, estimating, reporting, and day-to-day operations.

Miri works across four practice areas — Operations, Finance, Digital, and HR — and specializes in implementing and cleaning up industry-standard software such as Aspire, Buildertrend, and QuickBooks, then connecting it to how the business actually runs. Service area: United States. To get in touch, book an introductory call through the Calendly scheduling link on the site.

## Pages

- [Home](https://miri-consulting.com/): Overview of Miri Consulting — services (Operations, Finance, Digital, HR), industries served, client testimonials, and the team.
- [Aspire Consulting for Landscape Companies](https://miri-consulting.com/aspire-consulting-for-landscape-companies/): Aspire consulting for US landscape companies — Aspire setup and cleanup (item catalogs, kits, production factors, permissions, templates, dashboards and reporting), Aspire + QuickBooks month-end close and job-cost variance review, and landscape operations consulting (field-to-office workflows, estimating, job costing, KPI cadence). For companies implementing Aspire, or already live but not getting clean, trusted reporting.
- [Miri Relay](https://miri-consulting.com/products/): Miri Relay adds tools on top of the Aspire data a landscape company already maintains. Available now: Service Notifications (one consolidated customer text when several services are scheduled, instead of one text per Aspire work ticket, with control over which services notify; requires Aspire plus Quo or Dialpad for SMS), Directory (one-off and scheduled messages to customers, employees, subcontractors, and others), and a free Plant Library (15,000+ plants; find, save, share, and build Aspire-ready plant lists). Pricing on the page: Service Notifications $300/mo, Directory $150/mo, bundle $350/mo, plus a $1,000 onboarding fee for Service Notifications and Directory. App: https://relay.miri-consulting.com.
